# CWE-798: Artifactory token — high-entropy secret in source.
# Tokens like AKC... are checked into git and exposed. The rule flags
# them; fix by removing the secret or using a placeholder.
# ruleid: detected-artifactory-token
api_key = AKCqwertyuiop1234567890
# ruleid: detected-artifactory-token
token: AKCabcdef12345XYZ67890
# ok: detected-artifactory-token
api_key = "changeme"
# ok: detected-artifactory-token
# This is a placeholder AKC
# ruleid: detected-artifactory-token
secret = AKC9x8y7z6w5v4u3t2s1r0q9p8o7n6m5
# ruleid: detected-artifactory-token
key: AKC1a2b3c4d5e6f7g8h9i0j1k2l3m4n5o6
# ok: detected-artifactory-token
token = AKCaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa
